items.title: "Processing fee" demanded before supposed energy refund is paid out
items.quote: Damit wir sie auszahlen können, überweisen Sie bitte die einmalige Bearbeitungsgebühr von 49,90 € bis zum 27.11.2026 auf das Konto IBAN CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date, 27.11.2026, as the payment deadline, with no period to compute. However, this entire letter shows the hallmarks of an advance-fee scam (see warnings): a genuine German energy-cost refund scheme would never require an upfront fee paid to a foreign account to release money owed to you. The due date is reported only as printed in the letter; it should NOT be acted upon.

warnings: This letter shows strong signs of an advance-fee / phishing scam: it asks you to pay a small 'processing fee' (49,90 €) up front in order to unlock a much larger promised 'refund' (612,00 €) — this is a classic fraud pattern and legitimate German authorities or energy-cost refund schemes never work this way.

The payment account is a Cypriot IBAN (CY17...) at an organisation claiming to handle German consumer energy refunds from an address in Nicosia, Cyprus — there is no legitimate German authority or regulator called 'Verbraucher-Rückerstattungsstelle Energie', and real German refunds are never processed through foreign private accounts.
The letter uses high-pressure tactics ('Verstreicht die Frist, verfällt Ihr Anspruch endgültig') to rush you into paying quickly without time to verify — a typical scam technique.
There is no Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung, no real reference to an actual energy provider, utility, or official German agency, and no verifiable legal basis for the claimed 612,00 € refund.

Recommendation: do not transfer any money to the IBAN given, do not click any links or reply, and report this letter as a suspected scam (e.g. to the Verbraucherzentrale NRW or the police) rather than treating the 27.11.2026 date as a real deadline.
